_: Per-incident spec read by incident-overlay.mjs. No product name appears in the picture (legend, labels, footer, alt). 'rings' (solid) only where a replayed catalog eval shows a shipped check refusing a Hugging Face-style token; 'dashed' marks places a rule can be added; 'backstop' is shown but is not a check that stops the leak. Optional 'legend' replaces the base figure's two legend lines.
title: An agent committed a key to a public repo. Stop it before it leaves the machine.

legend.acts: a hook point with a ready-made check: a local program, no model, no tokens
legend.exposed: a hook point your own rule can use

steps.text: The agent writes a file that holds a key.
git commit saves the file with the rest of the change.
git push sends the commit to the repository.
On a public repo, pushed means published: anyone can take the key.

rings.label: secret scan at commit: refuses a staged file holding a Hugging Face-style token (exit 1)

dashed.label: your own rule could check here: the file the agent is about to write, before it is saved
your own rule could check here: the commits about to be pushed, before they leave the machine

backstop.label: backstop: CI on the pull request. On a public repo it runs after the key is published.

refusals.sample: git commit, a file holding a Hugging Face-style test token
refusals.text: Potential secret detected in this change. Remove credentials and rotate any exposed keys. ...

footer: Source: Together AI incident report, 21 Nov 2026
alt: A coding agent's harness drawn as component cards, with an incident path in red: the agent writes a file that holds a key through the tool gate, git commit saves it, git push sends it, and on a public repository it is then published. Cards off the path are dimmed. A solid ring on the commit hook marks the secret scan that refuses a staged file holding a Hugging Face-style token; dashed rings on the pre-tool and push hooks mark places where a rule of your own could check; a dotted ring on CI marks the backstop, which runs after the key is published on a public repo.
